title: Concept: Meta refresh sends the browser to another origin
description: A meta refresh is a redirect expressed in markup, so the usual protections on response headers do not see it. When the target is built from a request parameter the page becomes an open redirect, which is the standard first step of a phishing chain that starts on a trusted domain.
applicability: Responses that render a refresh timer or a post-action hop.
risk: The caller sends a link on the trusted domain that lands on a hostile page, which is usable for credential phishing.
